title: Week 26
subtitle: The eyes are opening. The third trimester starts next week.

baby.size: About the size of a scallion bunch
baby.development: The eyes are opening for the first time. The baby can hear and may respond to your voice with a kick. The lungs are still maturing, and the brain is developing the grooves that will hold memory.

you.body: Your uterus is about three inches above your belly button. You may have more backache, more heartburn, and trouble sleeping. Braxton Hicks may be more noticeable.
you.mind: The third trimester can bring a mix of impatience and dread. Both are ordinary. If you are feeling low most days, tell your OB — that is a treatable thing, not a personality.

coreActions.title: Get the Tdap vaccine
coreActions.why: It is recommended in every pregnancy, and the antibodies cross the placenta to protect the baby before they can be vaccinated. Whooping cough is most dangerous in the first months.
coreActions.detail: The window is 27 to 36 weeks, and earlier in that window is better so the antibodies have time. Ask your OB to schedule it at a visit, or get it at a pharmacy. Your partner and anyone who will be around the baby should also be up to date.

options.label: At your OB's office
options.detail: Simplest. Ask them to add it to a visit.

options.label: At a pharmacy
options.detail: Often free with insurance and no appointment needed.

coreActions.skipIf: You have already had Tdap in this pregnancy.

coreActions.title: Tell someone if you feel low most days
coreActions.why: Depression and anxiety in pregnancy are common and treatable. They are not a sign of weakness, and they do not make you a bad parent.
coreActions.detail: The signs are feeling low or hopeless most days for two weeks, losing interest in things, sleeping badly even when you can, or feeling anxious in a way that stops you doing things. Your OB can screen for it and refer you. Treatment in pregnancy is safe and it works.

options.label: Tell your OB at the next visit
options.detail: They screen for this routinely. It is a normal thing to raise.

options.label: Call the PSI HelpLine
options.detail: 1-800-944-4773. Free, and they will find you local support.

options.label: Call or text 988
options.detail: If you are thinking about hurting yourself, call now. It is free and 24 hours.

coreActions.title: Set up a safe sleep space
coreActions.why: The baby will sleep in your room for the first months, but the sleep space still needs to be right. It is the one piece of gear with a safety standard attached.
coreActions.detail: A firm flat mattress with a fitted sheet, in a crib, bassinet, or play yard that meets the federal standard. No bumpers, no pillows, no blankets, no toys. A sleep sack instead of a blanket. The crib slats should be no more than 2 3/8 inches apart. Check for recalls before you use anything secondhand.

options.label: A bassinet
options.detail: Small, portable, and in your room. Outgrown in about five months.

options.label: A crib
options.detail: Lasts years. Must meet 16 CFR 1219 if it is a full-size crib.

options.label: A play yard
options.detail: Doubles as a travel bed. Cheaper than a crib and smaller.

coreActions.noChooser: Any of these is safe if it meets the federal standard and is set up bare. The choice is about space and budget, not safety.
coreActions.skipIf: You already have a safe sleep space set up.

alsoKnow.title: The safe sleep rules are short
alsoKnow.body: On the back, on a firm flat surface, in the same room as you, with nothing else in the bed. No bumpers, no blankets, no pillows, no toys. That is the whole list.

alsoKnow.title: Hemorrhoids are common and treatable
alsoKnow.body: Pressure and constipation both contribute. Fiber, water, and not straining help. Ask your OB about a cream if they are painful.

alsoKnow.title: Tightenings that stop are not labor
alsoKnow.body: Braxton Hicks are irregular and ease with rest or water. Contractions that get closer together and stronger do not. If you are timing them, call.

redFlags.text: A clear change in your baby's usual movement
A severe headache that will not go, or blurred vision or spots
Thoughts of hurting yourself or ending your life

appointments.label: Tdap vaccine
appointments.note: Earlier in the window is better.

appointments.label: Prenatal visit
appointments.note: Ask about the glucose result and the Tdap date.
